The '''chests''' contain the rewards after completing [[The Fractured Archive]]. They are found in an otherwordly plane reached by communing with [[The Blade]]. Eight chests containing standard loot lie along the perimiter of the circular room, with a particular player only being able to open their personal chest which sparkles and shines slightly more brightly than the rest. If a unique reward has been earned, a special chest appears on an elevated platform at the northern end of the chamber.

Upon opening a standard chest, its crystalline exterior shatters and leaves behind a rift. A loot interface opens from which items can be banked, taken into the inventory, or destroyed. If a player leaves the room before claiming their loot, it will be held in the [[Loot Wheelbarrow|loot wheelbarrow]] in the lobby.
